nm ROIC CHECK prefetch/forensic.json roic: FY2026 ROIC 94.9% on the average of opening and closing capital, incremental ROIC 80.4%. Its FY2026 invested capital 154,157 = equity 157,293 + long-term debt 7,469 - cash and equivalents 10,605: it omits the current portion of debt (999) and operating leases (long-term 2,572 at FY2026, 4,985 at 2026-07-26), small effects (full-debt basis 94.5%), and it subtracts ONLY cash and equivalents, so marketable securities (51,951 at FY2026; 76,926 at 2026-07-26 = debt 34,143 + equity 42,783) and non-marketable securities (22,251; 51,157) stay inside invested capital although they are investment assets (they belong in the capital bridge, not in operating capital); equity also carries retained unrealized equity gains (23.7B in H1 FY2027). Excluding them, invested capital is 41,193 (FY2025) and 80,954 (FY2026): FY2026 ROIC 181% on average capital (137% on closing capital); TTM to 2026-07-26 about 172% (NOPAT about 165.9B at the 16.0% TTM effective tax rate over the average of 80,954 and 111,824) against about 84% on the forensic basis. Either basis is far above the 8% reference cost of capital; the forensic figure understates operating returns, and neither is a steady-state number (no restricted cash in the balance sheet lines read).

nm TRACK RECORD revenue ratio 1.0499 over 8 periods, 8 beats, 0 misses: NVIDIA guides a revenue midpoint with a plus-or-minus 2% range and has delivered 2.5% to 7.9% above the midpoint in each of the last 8 guided quarters (Q3 FY2025 to Q2 FY2027: guided 32.5, 37.5, 43.0, 45.0, 54.0, 65.0, 78.0, 91.0 billion; actual 35.08, 39.33, 44.06, 46.74, 57.01, 68.13, 81.62, 96.22), every one above the top of its own range: it guides conservatively. The guided midpoints were re-read against the release text in reading/release_*pr.txt and the Q2 FY2025 release (raw_reports) on 2026-10-26 and match; the rows (27: revenue, GAAP gross margin, GAAP operating expenses; rp_ ids, sources renamed pf_rel_* at merge) are kept in place in gather/reports.json (gather_documents file) so they are not entered twice. The outstanding guide is Q3 FY2027 revenue 108.0B +/-2% (not yet reported). A ratio of this kind says how the guide has been beaten, not that the next quarter will be.

nm EXPOSURES (share exposed): China (incl. Hong Kong) customer-HQ revenue 9.1% of FY2026 and 8.2% of Q2 FY2027 revenue, but China data-center compute shipments were below 1% of Data Center revenue in Q2 FY2027 and the company calls itself effectively foreclosed from China data-center compute: the data-center China loss is already out of the run rate; residual China exposure is mostly uncontrolled products (gaming/workstation) and customer-HQ attribution. Charges so far: H20 $4.5B (Q1 FY2026), H200 $0.4B (H1 FY2027); licensed H200 imports carry a 25% US tariff not passed on.

nm EXPOSURES Taiwan: wafers from foundries TSMC and Samsung, CoWoS packaging, supply chain mainly concentrated in Asia (10-K); Taiwan holds 31.0% of long-lived assets (3,219 of 10,383) and Taiwan-HQ customers 19.6% of FY2026 and 28.0% of Q2 FY2027 revenue (76% of FY2026 Taiwan-HQ Data Center revenue attributed to US/European end customers, i.e. ODM pass-through). The share of wafer/packaging capacity located in Taiwan is not disclosed (gap). Regulation: AI Diffusion IFR rescinded May 2025, replacement rule pending (scope unknown); EU AI Act; gaming-GPU export controls possible.
nm CONCENTRATION: FY2026 two direct customers 22% and 14% of revenue; H1 FY2027 three direct customers 16%, 15%, 13% (44% together); Q2 FY2027 one direct customer 16%.
nm DIVIDEND: quarterly dividend raised from $0.01 to $0.25 per share (ex-dates 2026-06-04 and 2026-09-10 per IB corporate actions; 10-Q equity statement $0.25 in Q2 FY2027): about $6.0B a quarter.
